ov: Insects with a single pair of wings; the hind pair became small balancing organs. There are over 150,000 species, from Gauromydas heros, up to 7 cm long, to one smaller than a grain of salt. The housefly has spread worldwide alongside people.
df: Liquids: houseflies soften solid food with saliva and taste it with their feet.

cf.tip: Mosquitoes are small flies with a long piercing mouthpart. Most other flies lap up liquids instead.

fx: Flies are major pollinators, second only to bees and their relatives.
The first true flies date from about 240 million years ago, in the Middle Triassic.
notes: Group entry (alias housefly). The existing fact (sees time more slowly than you) is confirmed: houseflies process visual information about seven times faster than humans and see our movements "in slow motion".
